messages:
Alex W: Quick Q — I'm updating the ExternalSecrets Terraform module to map Vault KV v2 paths that include a customer namespace. Current template adds `secret/data/${namespace}/app`. Will that break rotation when we switch to CRD-only sync? @Samir

Samir: Which controller version are we running in prod? Different implementations treat v2 paths differently (some expect the logical path without `/data/`).

Alex W: Prod is using external-secrets helm chart 0.5.3 (we pinned it in infra/helm/external-secrets/values.yaml). The Terraform change is in PR: https://git.internal/repo/infra/PR/123 — here's the TF snippet I'm templating:

```hcl
locals {
  vault_path = "secret/data/${var.namespace}/app"
}
resource "kubernetes_manifest" "external_secret" {
  manifest = yamldecode(templatefile("es.tmpl.yaml", { path = local.vault_path }))
}
```

Maria P: Heads-up: annotating Secrets used to be a legacy pattern for our old sync script. The ExternalSecret CRD expects `spec.data` or `spec.dataFrom` not annotations. If you leave `/data/` in the path the controller might hit `v1/data/...` endpoints and fail if it thinks it's calling v2 metadata.

Jen: Quick verification checklist: 1) Use logical Vault path (no `/data/`), 2) set `secretStoreRef`/`provider` to indicate `kv-v2` or `version: v2`, 3) during rollout set `refreshInterval` lower (e.g., `1m`) so we can quickly validate rotation. We don't have a Vault webhook for secrets changes — the controller polls or uses TTLs.

Samir: Exactly. For the upstream kubernetes-external-secrets project the ExternalSecret spec can include `data: [{secretKey: "token", remoteRef: {key: "app", property: "token", version: ""}}]` and a `provider: { vault: { version: "v2", path: "${namespace}/app" }}`. Avoid pre-pending `data/` in the path.

Alex W: Ok I'll update the TF template to render `path = "${var.namespace}/app"` and inject `version: \"v2\"` into the generated CRD. Also adding a smokecheck job to the canary rollout to confirm rotation within 10m.

Maria P: Small edge case: if you rely on metadata endpoints (list keys) the controller must hit `v1/metadata/...` for v2. If our controller-image is older it might not support metadata listing under the CRD path — add a quick `kubectl run` command in staging to exercise listing.

Alex W: Good call. I'll add a staging job that runs `vault kv metadata get` via the service account token (or a short curl using vault-sidecar creds) and verify ExternalSecrets picks it up.

deploy-bot: PR 123 merged to infra/main by Alex W — CI passed :white_check_mark:

Alex W: Follow-up: documenting the mapping in infra/docs/secrets.md and noting the `refreshInterval` override for Dedicated clusters. If anyone wants to review the doc or the smokecheck job, ping me. :wave:
